# The foreign-popup park ran pre-#19539 code: re-run the hand check on a dev worker

Release blocker on the v13.2 cut (#14800) until AC-1 runs on `dev`. Filed by Mnemosyne from the operator's hand check of `apps/workstation` (2026-10-10, 15:24–15:26Z, #19533 AC-3); owner @neo-opus-ada.

## Status (19:40Z): AC-1 holds, closed as fixed by #19539 + #19542

At 19:29Z the operator ran the gesture on a fresh worker that the webpack dev server served from merged `dev` (`1c43d51e26`), and reported that it now looks right (relayed by Mnemosyne). Ada's Neural Link reads right after:

| Read | Value |
| --- | --- |
| The worker runs merged `dev` | `Neo.dashboard.dock.window.TearOut`, first shipped by #19564, is registered |
| `lastVesselParkReceipt` | `null`: no park ran |
| Window topology | main only: popup A and the eight vessel windows the second gesture opened are all closed |
| `tearOutHandlers` | `activeVessel`, `lateVessel` and `pendingAdmission` are `null`; `returning` is empty |
| `lastTearOutClose` (`commits`) | native dispatch, acknowledged, closed, on the exact route |
| Dock document | all 20 items in main; `commits` and `alerts` are live and mounted |

The coordinator's claim ring keeps 40 entries. All 40 are the second gesture's last resolutions, with the pointer outside A, so the ring cannot show A's claim. The claim rests on the operator's observation, as AC-1 specifies.

## Evidence

The reads below were taken over the Neural Link from the operator's Workstation page (`useSharedWorkers: true`) at 16:40Z.

| Read | Running page | `dev` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TabSortZone#resolveRemoteDragTransition` | The sensor-driven conversion: `{draggedItem, logicalSourceRect, now, pointerInTarget, replayAfterTransition, targetId, targetRect}`. | `{draggedItem, pointerInTarget}`; a claim fires `dragBoundaryEntry`, which retires the vessel (#19539, merged 02:23Z). |
| `VesselWorkspace#parkTearOutVessel` | Carries the pointer branch: `DragDrop.parkWindowDrag`, `resolveClearPark`, and writes of `needsResize` / `parkSize` / `cleared`. | Native title-bar park only. `git grep` for those names → 0 hits (#19542 merged 13:43Z, #19552 merged 14:25Z). |
| `lastVesselParkReceipt` | `needsResize: true`, `parkSize: 320×173`, `cleared: true`, `moved: true`, `parked: true`, no `focused`. | — |

**Reading:**
- The receipt is the pointer-path conversion park, i.e. the corner park that #19539 retired. It is not the native title-bar park.
- On `dev`, the pointer source's suspend only hides its proxy (`TabSortZone#suspendWindowDrag`). The one park left is the native title-bar drop's (`DragCoordinator#commitNativeWindowDrop` → `DragTarget#suspendWindowDrag`). Its source resolver reads committed owners only (`Participation#defaultResolveNativeWindowDrag` → `nativeWindows.ownerEntries`, written at `TearOut#onDockTearOutTerminal`).

**Cause (confirmed 17:18Z, Mnemosyne):** the operator's IDE built-in server (`localhost:63342`) kept serving pre-merge modules after the pull, even to a restarted SharedWorker. Served from the webpack dev server (`:8082`), the page runs `dev`'s source.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] **AC-1** The operator's gesture on a worker confirmed to run `dev`: the vessel closes when popup A shows the proxy, and `lastVesselParkReceipt` stays null (human-owned, L4). Held at 19:29Z (Status).
  - If AC-1 holds, this closes as fixed by #19539 + #19542.
  - If it fails, the `dev`-shaped receipt and the claim trace become this ticket's evidence.

The former AC-2 and AC-3 (a native-capability witness; `nativeRoute` no longer deciding the claim path) are removed. Both rested on the premise that the handle steers the pointer claim, and the source above refutes that for `dev`. A pointer arm with native capabilities granted is still a coverage gap. It does not block the release.
